notes: PHASE 9. The item rows for items_gear.json, read AFTER docks-pieces-items.json (static_pieces.cpp, StaticCatalogue::load) so every row of the two files before it keeps its variant number; neither of them is edited.

Same shape as those tables. The weapons and the shields are the licensed packs' own SM_Wep files laid down by a pitch: a quarter turn the positive way stands an axe or a hammer on the face of its head, the negative way lays the boarding axe on its back with the blade up, and a shield lies flat on its rim. The hatchet is the cleaver head, the maul the long war hammer, the boarding axe the bearded axe the viewmodel holds.

The armour has no file of its own in any pack, so it is what the coat, the hood and the boots already are: a sack at a hand's size and a tint, the gambeson a rolled quilt, the iron pot the camp pot it is named for.
Every row's lift puts its lowest point on the boards; the drawn span (lift + the turned mesh at its scale) is what items_gear.json's drawnCm says, pinned against the meshes by test_kit_page.
